items.name: article-body
items.title: Article body
items.description: A public article body: the stored document drawn by CmsContent, with an optional table of contents above it.

items.name: field-row
items.title: Field row
items.description: One form field of the entry editor drawn on useField: label, input for the value, error text and read-only state.

items.name: entry-editor
items.title: Entry editor
items.description: A minimal custom editor screen for one entry, built on useEntryEditor and useField: fields, save and publish, recovery and conflict.

items.name: notice-block-view
items.title: Notice block view
items.description: An edit view for a `notice` block, registered through blockViews: an editable title, a level switch and the nested body (BlockFrame, Content, useBlockEditor).

items.name: blog-theme
items.title: Blog theme
items.description: A thin blog theme for one collection: a paged post list and a post detail page (title, date, author, table of contents, body, previous and next post) with metadata, 404 and redirects. Pages are written to app/(site)/blog, plus a draft preview page at app/(site)/preview/blog (for site.previewPath = /preview).
